strings: r_c0 helps m_c stay on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws while guiding {PRONOUN/m_c/object} towards the medicine den to rest in until this period of dizziness passes.
m_c stands up too quickly and finds the world spinning around {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
It seems every time m_c moves too suddenly, a new wave of dizziness hits {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
m_c hisses when a Clanmate says that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} should just be more careful when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stand/stands} up.
